org.name: Avon and Wiltshire Mental Health NHS Trust

hazard: Lack of documented risk assessment at admission

promises.quote: The adoption of this new paperwork ensures risks are clearly identified for detainees and its success will be evaluated in 3 months.
promises.summary: Adopt new risk assessment paperwork with evaluation in 3 months

concerns.quote: there is no documented risk assessment produced at the time of a service user's admission onto Mason Unit
concerns.hazard: lack of documented risk assessment at admission

concerns.quote: the nurse in charge made no record on the computerised Rio notes in relation to the admission
concerns.hazard: missing admission record in Rio notes

concerns.quote: consider whether guidance or training ought to be provided to staff on how to set patient observation levels when being admitted onto Mason Unit; what factors to take into account when assessing a service users risk of suicide or self-harm and how to manage that risk appropriately and how to appropriately communicate that risk to other staff
concerns.hazard: inadequate staff guidance on observation and risk communication

concerns.quote: gross failures in respect of the care provided to the deceased by your trust to the extent that the jury found that the deceased's death had been contributed to by neglect
Care, Risk and Crisis Management plans were not robust enough and failed to contain sufficient information
Staff had insufficient knowledge of how to access, interrogate and effectively use computerised medical records
There was a lack of involvement of family members and in particular, the concept of a triangle of care which involved family, the patient and the medical team had largely been ignored
There did not appear to be a system of peer review within the mental health teams nor a system of external audit as regards the adequacy of care plans and medical records
concerns.hazard: absence of peer review and audit

concerns.quote: Unqualified staff were relied upon in circumstances where qualified staff should have been assigned

links.explanation: Both reports highlight shortcomings in documenting and using risk-related information for service users. The earlier report notes missing admission risk assessments, while the later report finds care and crisis plans lacking sufficient detail.
links.earlier_quote: (1) [heard evidence that there is no documented risk assessment produced at the time of a service user's admission onto Mason Unit. | would ask that you review whether this is still appropriate.
links.later_quote: 1. Care, Risk and Crisis Management plans were not robust enough and failed to contain sufficient information.
links.promise_quote: The adoption of this new paperwork ensures risks are clearly identified for detainees and its success will be evaluated in 3 months.
